scripts.dev:clean: if lsof -ti:3000 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 $(lsof -ti:3000); fi; if lsof -ti:3001 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 $(lsof -ti:3001); fi; rm -f .next/dev/lock; next dev
scripts.dev:clean:next: for p in 3000 3001; do for pid in $(lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); do cmd=$(ps -p $pid -o command= 2>/dev/null || true); echo "$cmd" | grep -Eiq 'next dev|next-server|turbopack' && kill -9 $pid || true; done; done; rm -f .next/dev/lock; next dev
scripts.dev:doctor: echo '=== PORTS ==='; echo '3000:'; lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true; echo '3001:'; lsof -nP -iTCP:3001 -sTCP:LISTEN || true; echo; echo '=== LOCK ==='; ls -la .next/dev/lock 2>/dev/null || echo 'no lock'; echo; echo '=== NEXT PROCESSES ==='; ps aux | grep -E 'next dev|next-server|turbopack' | grep -v grep || true; echo; echo '=== ENV (presence only, loads .env.local if present) ==='; node -e "try{require('dotenv').config({path:'.env.local'});}catch{}; const ks=['NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL','NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY','SUPABASE_URL','SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY','KHASHIKA_CATALOG_FILE']; for (const k of ks) console.log(k+': '+(process.env[k]?'SET':'MISSING'));"
scripts.fix: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 || true; rm -rf .next; npm run dev
scripts.fix:clean: pkill -f next || true; rm -rf .next; npm run dev
